overview: A SaaS-scalable mini-ERP for restaurant financial and operational management. Built with a strict modular architecture separating generic business logic (finance, HR) from restaurant-specific features (menus, recipes). Sprint 1 establishes the foundational folder structure, TypeScript interfaces, and navigation layout.
features: TypeScript interfaces for Expenses, Salaries, Loans, Recipes, Ingredients
Responsive Layout with collapsible Sidebar navigation
Four navigation sections: Paramètres, Business Plan, Simulateur Carte, Quotidien
Domain-split hooks structure for future TanStack Query integration
Pure math utility structure enforcing no calculations in components
